text: {"voice": 3, "model_prose": 3, "fidelity": 4, "note": "The semicolon and the phrase 'admits, in its own nature, of no answer' catch something of the Johnsonian register, but the four short, evenly weighted sentences, the clipped opening assertion and the cadenced image-close read as tidy modern prose; fidelity is good, though the text's refusal to choose becomes the narrator's and 'holds together' is softened to 'left together'."}
